Subtract 307 days from 1985-02-01.  
1985 is not a leap year (1984 was leap, 1985 is not).  
307 days back from Feb 1: go to Jan 1 (31 days back) → 1985-01-01.  
Remaining 307 − 31 = 276 days to go back into 1984 (leap year).  
From 1985-01-01 back 276 days:  
Dec 1984: 31 days → 1984-12-01 (back 31 days total from Jan 1).  
Remaining 276 − 31 = 245 days earlier in 1984.  
From Dec 1 back 245 days:  
Nov: 30, Oct: 31, Sep: 30, Aug: 31, Jul: 31, Jun: 30, May: 31, Apr: 30, Mar: 31, Feb: 29 (leap), Jan: 31.  
Sum from Nov back: 30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31+29 = 304 days to go from Dec 1 to Jan 31 of 1984.  
We need only 245 days back from Dec 1:  
Nov: 30 → 1984-11-01 (back 30 days)  
Remaining 245 − 30 = 215 days earlier.  
Oct: 31 → 1984-10-01 (back 61 days total)  
Remaining 215 − 31 = 184 days earlier.  
Sep: 30 → 1984-09-01 (back 91 days total)  
Remaining 184 − 30 = 154 days earlier.  
Aug: 31 → 1984-08-01 (back 122 days total)  
Remaining 154 − 31 = 123 days earlier.  
Jul: 31 → 1984-07-01 (back 153 days total)  
Remaining 123 − 31 = 92 days earlier.  
Jun: 30 → 1984-06-01 (back 183 days total)  
Remaining 92 − 30 = 62 days earlier.  
May: 31 → 1984-05-01 (back 214 days total)  
Remaining 62 − 31 = 31 days earlier.
